# GUOYAO METAL

> Architectural metalworks. Material, form and the details that shape a space.

Company: 广州市国耀高薪材料科技有限公司.
Official website: https://www.guoyaometal.com.

## Website

- [Home](https://www.guoyaometal.com/): The Guoyao Metal perspective on material and space.
- [Case Studies](https://www.guoyaometal.com/case-studies): Published project stories and their material details.
- [Blog](https://www.guoyaometal.com/blog): The material journal.
- [About](https://www.guoyaometal.com/about): Brand perspective and company identity.

Concept imagery is labeled on the website. Published case studies and articles provide their own project or subject context. Use the project enquiry form to discuss a brief.
